tabs.tab_content: No. You’ll learn the same framework we use with partners and leave with a plan you can run yourself. If you want help afterwards, you know where we are.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need to prepare anything?
tabs.tab_content: Just a laptop and a quiet half hour before. If you have them, your last three months of marketing numbers make the hands-on parts more useful.
Yes. Everyone who registers gets the recording and the worksheet, even if you can’t make it live.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need a Zoom account?
tabs.tab_content: No. The link opens in your browser or the free Zoom app. Camera on is welcome but optional.

tabs.tab_title: What if I can’t make it?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM refund policy] Let us know up to [48 hours] before and we’ll move you to a future date. Everyone who registers gets the recording.

tabs.tab_title: Is it right for my industry?
tabs.tab_content: The framework works for any local, service-based business: trades, health and wellness, professional services, retail and more. The examples are all from New Hampshire businesses.
